notes.title: Hotfix - 1.0.6
notes.content: [p]Hello, Travelers![/p][p][/p][p]In this Hotfix, we’ve focused on addressing several key bugs and improving stability to make your adventure smoother and more enjoyable. [/p][p]We’ll continue to monitor your feedback and refine the game accordingly.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your unwavering support.[/p][p][b]– Lizard Smoothie[/b]💫[/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5 Note

ahead toward what's next.[/p][p]Thank you for playing, and good luck with the journey![/p][p][/p][h1]Changes[/h1][list][*][p]Increased bonus Stardust obtained by defeating Heroic Bosses at higher notes.title: PATCH 1.0.5 INCOMING!

notes.title: 2025/09/12 - Hotfix Note
notes.content:
[p]Hello, Travelers![/p][p]Thank you to everyone who has played Shape of Dreams and sent us various feedback.[/p][p][/p][p]Since launch, we have been analyzing the play data together with your voices, and we are quickly refining the parts that need improvement.
This hotfix was prepared with a focus on easing growth stress, increasing rewards, and adjusting difficulty, which many of you have commented on.[/p][p][/p][p]We will continue to closely examine the data and, together with the community’s feedback, further solidify the unique fun of Shape of Dreams.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]\[Hotfix Notes][/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added a feature to reset purchased stars[/p][/*][*][p]Now, when you press the purchase or enhance button in the constellation screen, the star is immediately purchased/enhanced.[/p][/*][*][p]Traveler Mastery experience improvements[/p][list][*][p]The number of points gained by beginners is increased.[/p][/*][*][p]The number of points gained by players who explore the world for a long time is increased.[/p][/*][*][p]The amount of points gained by speedrunners who progress quickly through the game is increased.[/p][/*][*][p]The amount of points required to level up when Traveler Mastery is level 20 or higher is reduced.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Reduced enemy HP and damage growth values in Easy and Normal difficulties[/p][/*][*][p]Increased base Stardust drop amount from defeating Hero Bosses (12 ⇒ 16)[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Stardust reward obtained when completing achievements (40 ⇒ 50)[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Stardust reward obtained when appraising relics (10 ⇒ 20)[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the animation time of Balanced Beam by 60% when it ends[/p][/*][*][p]The knockback strength of the basic attacks of Infernas, the boss of Phyrana’s Earth, now decreases as the difficulty becomes easier.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the burn damage duration applied to Travelers by 30%[/p][/*][*][p]Relaxed the completion conditions for 11 achievements that required excessive time to complete[/p][list][*][p]"Pure Immagination", "Horns, Feathers, and Gold", "Praise the Sun!", "Elemental Lord", "Empty Canvas", "Full Moon", "Hunters? What Hunters?", "Midas Incarnate", "Mine and Craft", "I've Got This!", "Reap What You Sow"[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]With this hotfix, if the completion conditions for an achievement are now met due to the adjusted requirements, the achievement will automatically unlock when you start the game.[/p][list][*][p]Reduced the stun effect duration of the red magic circle of the Seeker boss in the Cave of Oblivion by 50%[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]\[Bug Fixes][/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where the safe zone sometimes generated too far away during White Night’s special attack in Lotus Plateau[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where cooldown reduction was not displayed in the tooltip when enhancing Memories[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the achievement was not completed even when a soul was infused into the wooden puppet in certain situations[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where reconnection or mid-session joining was not possible in certain situations[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the sunglasses worn by the Hollow Traveler were displayed in the wrong position[/p][/*][/list][p]We ask for your continued interest and feedback, and we will do our best to make your adventure even more enjoyable.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your unwavering support.[/p][p][b]– Lizard Smoothie[/b]💫[/p]

notes.title: 2025/09/11 - Hotfix Note
notes.content:
[p]Hello, Travelers![/p][p]Thank you for the tremendous support you have shown since launch, and we also deeply empathize with the frustration and disappointment some of you have felt.[/p][p][/p][p]The Traveler Mastery system was designed to bring players a sense of growth and progression, but in many ways, we now see that we did not consider enough of its impact.[/p][p][/p][p]As a result, this system failed to fully capture the core fun of [i]Shape of Dreams[/i] and did not sufficiently respect the experience of players who enjoyed the demo and prologue.[/p][p][/p][p]Based on your feedback, we have prepared this hotfix, and we will continue to monitor gameplay closely and make ongoing improvements in the future.[/p][p][/p][p][b]\[Hotfix Notes][/b][/p][list][*][p]Grant Traveler Mastery rewards proportional to play time to existing demo/prologue players[/p][list][*][p]If you played the demo or prologue for more than 10 minutes, when you run the game, a reward claim window will appear.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Increase Stardust reward amounts for Daydream quests by 25 ~ 100%[/p][/*][*][p]Remove the time between completing a Daydream quest and assigning the next quest[/p][/*][*][p]Lower Nakia Traveler's challenge requirement from 30 defeats ⇒ 20 defeats[/p][/*][*][p]Reduce the number of points required to raise Traveler Mastery levels across the board[/p][/*][*][p]Required mastery level to unlock all Flexible Stars decreased by 5 levels[/p][/*][*][p]When upgrading Memories, the cooldown will no longer converge at 50% and will continue to decrease.[/p][list][*][p]Reflecting feedback from many demo players about enjoyment and difficulty, we have rolled back that change, which was a balance patch for the full version.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where constellation tree refunds did not work properly in some situations[/p][/*][/list][p]⚠️ [b]Please make sure to update the game before playing multiplayer.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Rules for Returning Proficiency Points:[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Proficiency points will be granted proportionally based on your demo playtime. The longer you played, the more points you would receive.[/p][list][*][p]Playtime under 10 minutes: No points will be granted.[/p][/*][*][p]Playtime between 10–60 minutes: Points will be granted as if you played for 60 minutes.[/p][/*][*][p]Playtime over 60 minutes: Points will be granted proportionally based on your actual playtime.[/p][/*][*][p]There is a maximum limit to the points you can receive, equal to the total points required to raise all five characters from level 0 to level 25.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Granted points can be freely distributed among the five unlockable demo characters: Lacerte, Mist, Yubar, Vesper, and Aurena.[/p][/*][/olist][p]Your valuable feedback is what makes [i]Shape of Dreams[/i] truly special.
We will keep listening to your voices and deliver a smoother, more satisfying adventure.[/p][p][/p][p]Let’s shape the dream together — we look forward to your continued support and participation. ✨[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for always cheering us on.
[b]– Lizard Smoothie[/b][/p]

notes.title: Shape of Dreams will be officially launched! Get Ready to Continue Your Journey
notes.content:
[h2]🎉 Shape of Dreams will be officially launched! 🎉[/h2][p][/p][p]Hello, Travelers! [/p][p][/p][p]The wait is over—[b]Shape of Dreams[/b] will be officially launched![/p][p] We want to thank you all for your incredible support, and we’ve prepared a variety of events and rewards to celebrate![/p][p]✨ [b]20% Launch Discount[/b]
For the first two weeks after release, Shape of Dreams will be available at a special discounted price![/p][p]✨ [b]Special Thank-You Events[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Early Bird Reward[/b]: Log in within 21 days after launch to receive the commemorative item [i]Ethereal Forest Hound[/i]![/p][/*][*][p][b]Pioneer’s Challenge[/b]: Defeat 8 bosses to unlock a [i]Limited Edition Emblem[/i]![/p][/*][/list][p]✨ [b]Special Bundle Releases (with an extra 10% discount!)[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Rock and Dream[/b]: Shape of Dreams + Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor[/p][/*][*][p][b]Dream of Snow[/b]: Shape of Dreams + Warm Snow
→ Enjoy Shape of Dreams alongside other hit titles at an additional 10% off![/p][/*][/list][p]The full release brings rich content and many exciting changes. Don’t miss out—step into the world of [b]Shape of Dreams[/b] now![/p][p][/p][h1]What Has Changed?[/h1][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44940776/4be2d106e4ca1f9b3dfafb3c614b475cc3204271.jpg"][/img][/p][p]First of all, we want to thank the [b]1,000,000+ Travelers[/b] who played the demo and prologue, shared feedback, and helped us improve the game. Here are some of the biggest changes in the full version:[/p][p][/p][h2]New Worlds & Multi-Biome System[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44940776/0a046a66b2de0101b312ae43289cecaa93bb9e12.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We have gone beyond the 3 worlds of the demo, and in the full version of the game, we are introducing a total of 8 worlds![/p][p]Previously, the game progressed in the order of Forest, Snowfield, and Night Sky, but now you will visit 5 worlds in the order of Forest, Spirit Land, Higher Dimension, Island of Despair, and Throne of the Lonely King.[/p][p]In addition, with the introduction of the multi-biome system, in the Spirit Land, one of the 3 biomes—Snowfield, Flame Zone, or Cave of Oblivion—will be randomly selected, and in the Higher Dimension, either the existing Night Sky or the Lotus Plateau will be randomly played. Each world contains unique enemies, challenges, rewards, and powerful bosses waiting.[/p][p]Also, in this full version, an ending has been added, allowing travelers’ journeys to finally come to a proper close. When you defeat the Hero Boss on the Island of Despair, you can choose to either return to the Turbulent Forest to repeat the game or enter the Throne of the Lonely King to end everything.[/p][p][/p][h2]Revamped Constellation & Traveler Mastery[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44940776/082045db16a009187cc06d60783f687863dd70f6.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We’ve completely reworked the constellation system to maximize build customization. Stars can now be purchased with [b]Star Dust[/b]. Unlocking additional stars requires [b]Traveler Mastery[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]Traveler Mastery increases as you play your favorite travelers. Leveling it up unlocks more stars and grants special rewards like [b]Traveler Banners[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]See our previous dev notes for details![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2444750/view/497195047298533099"][/dynamiclink][/p][h2]New Playable Travelers[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44940776/0e54016c4d2858426b9550936988b1d08fb3c9f4.png"][/img][/p][p]In the demo, there were already 5 different classes, but based on the hottest ideas requested by the community, we added Nachia (Summoner/Support), Shell (Assassin), and Bismuth (Stylish Mage) to the game. These travelers play in completely different styles from the existing ones, and each waits to journey with you through the Stream with their own unique constellations and builds.[/p][p][/p][h2]Continue Dreaming[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44940776/6b0c83170a1ae738253409f1f764423fb353cbbd.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Has it ever happened that your character is too powerful and sweeping away all the enemies, but suddenly you need to go somewhere? Or maybe your pet Komodo dragon pulled out your PC’s power plug, or it’s time to go to bed? In this full version, [b]the Save and Continue feature[/b]—requested by many users in the community—has been added, so even if you quit the game, you can resume your journey anytime![/p][p][/p][h2]Reconnect & Mid-Game Join[/h2][p][/p][p]We have added a reconnect feature so that players who left the game can rejoin and return! Even if you leave a co-op game or get disconnected, you can join the same lobby again and continue playing with your traveler and items as before.[/p][p]Also, we have added a mid-game join system so that new players can join games that are already in progress! When you join a lobby where the game is already ongoing, you can select the traveler you want to play and enter the game, and you will be granted appropriate amounts of memories, essences, and currency to help you quickly catch up to the game flow.[/p][p]Besides these, there are many more changes, but we have little space to mention them all. We hope these changes can enrich your journey.[/p][p][/p][h2]Save Data Transfer[/h2][p]Players who have played the demo or prologue versions can continue their save data directly in the full version![/p][p]Demo version and save transfer support will end 3 weeks after the full release, so please be sure to complete your save transfer along with receiving your launch event rewards before then.[/p][p][/p][p][u][i]*In the case of data transfer, playtime, achievements, unlocked memories, essences, and travelers, discovered memories and essences, discovered relics, and stardust will all be restored, and constellations will be reset, but all Stardust invested will be 100% refunded. [/i][/u][/p][p][u][i]However, for saves older than the prologue version, discovered relics may not be restored.[/i][/u][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]Thank you for joining the journey[/h1][p]As the developer, we are very happy to finally present Shape of Dreams to you after a long development time. And we truly thank the players who have patiently waited for such a long time.[/p][p][/p][p]But it is not over yet! You have sent us good ideas and feedback so far, and we know you will continue to do so. Accordingly, we plan to add features that the community has requested a lot, such as mod support, in the near future, and we will continue to improve the game by adding new items, systems, hidden bosses, diverse stories, and hardcore modes.[/p][p]We will announce more details on what updates you can look forward to in the future![/p][p][/p][p]✨ Bon Voyage![/p][p]🦎 Lizard Smoothie. [/p]

notes.title: Travel Log #2 - Constellation Sneak Peek & Traveler Mastery
notes.content:
Hello travelers! Are you enjoying your journey today?

In today's Travel Log, we'd like to give you a peek at the progress of the Constellation rework we mentioned last time, as well as introduce a new system coming in the future: Traveler Mastery!

[h1]What kind of Stars are we creating?[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44940776/644bf36886c3ba05ef946da87e1b558a7c440e8f.gif[/img]

Stars will no longer function as permanent upgrades, but instead will become [b]a flexible system where you can equip and unequip them from slots[/b]. Some stars are simple stat boosts, while others change the way you play a character. This allows you to make the game easier, harder, or give it a fresh feel. You can freely customize each traveler to your liking.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44940776/fe36e3f28ea8360c095e410e84dffdac4d34858b.gif[/img]

There are four types of stars and star slots: Destruction, Imagination, Life, and Flexibility. Each star must be equipped in the appropriate slot. However, there are some exception rules, such as stars equipped in different types of slots still functioning at 50% efficiency, or Flexibility stars and slots acting as a kind of "wild card" that isn't restricted by type.

Additionally, in response to feedback about the inconvenience of turning constellations on and off repeatedly, we've decided to add a feature that allows you to save multiple constellation builds and instantly load the one you want. We hope this constellation rework, which will be implemented in the full version of Shape of Dreams, will enhance the fun of character customization.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44940776/ea68bd0085adc940f50e4d75981705dbfd5cb093.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44940776/d0966fb64f2dc084f256631454ee56d107028d39.gif[/img]

[h1]Traveler Mastery[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44940776/e7a199dcea5fba9a0d7882373ebbc7d5a617ec16.png[/img]

Some of you play all travelers equally, while others might spend 10 hours on just a few characters. Either way, we all have our own ways of showing affection for our travelers. To reward players who spend a lot of time with their travelers, we've decided to add a system called [b]"Traveler Mastery"[/b].

By playing games with a specific traveler, you can collect Traveler Mastery points, and when you gather enough points, your level increases. This Traveler Mastery level will be displayed to other players in the lobby, allowing you to show everyone how much you love that intimidating hammer guy, and as you level up, you can earn exclusive rewards like special character emblems. New stars and additional slot counts will also be unlocked according to your level.



Please leave us feedback on these changes! We read all of your comments and will continue to work hard to make a better game based on your input.

Thank you for your patience. Happy travels!
The Shape of Dreams Development Team 💫

notes.title: Travel Log #1 - Delay Announcement + Development Diary Begins!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44940776/2be021ab934ce81dc815a8709798897b4aedc1be.png[/img]

Hello Travelers!

Thanks to your interest, we were able to successfully conclude our recent event! We are grateful for your support. Many of you sent us valuable feedback and opinions, and based on these, we've taken time to consider what needs to be improved before release and what needs to be added to make the game better. After reconsidering our development schedule, we've unfortunately made the difficult decision to delay the release date.

[h1]When will it be released?[/h1]

We aim to release Shape of Dreams between Q3-Q4 2025, and until then, we will prepare more content while improving the game experience.

Also, since this delay will make the wait longer, we've decided to regularly share what we're developing to help ease your anticipation! Here are some improvements that have been decided based on your feedback.


[h1]Gameplay Improvements[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44940776/d130db472a03bb46927157b425fc8826a466c975.jpg[/img]

We believe that looping back to the beginning is one of the most fun ways to play Shape of Dreams. Growing your character to the extreme and testing yourself to see how far you can go is truly an enjoyable experience. However, we've confirmed user feedback that this experience can become somewhat repetitive over time, especially for veteran players.

So, we're testing various methods to make the overall gameplay, especially the late game, more rich. In particular, we think that if bosses and monsters grow in unexpected ways, and players have to adapt and overcome these situations, it will enhance the challenging fun.


[h1]Constellation Rework[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44940776/5c9ac01d540a18b16728f58ce50e42b50a8da590.jpg[/img]

Constellations are the meta-progression system of Shape of Dreams. While it's an essential system that provides players with the fun of growth, many travelers have pointed out areas for improvement in the current constellation system. Among the feedback we've confirmed, the main opinions were as follows:
[list]
[*] Most are simple stat growths. There's a lack of upgrades that can change the experience in different ways.  
[*] When all trees are completed, the game becomes too easy because you become too powerful, and conversely, when no trees are completed, the game becomes too difficult. 
[/list]
We want to solve these problems and make the constellation system feel more strategic and provide better growth enjoyment. To this end, we're testing several interesting methods, such as stars that can be equipped and unequipped, and stars that have both strengths and weaknesses.


We believe these changes will greatly complement the weaknesses the game currently has. If you have any opinions on this or if you have good ideas, please share them with us on the Steam forum and Discord! You can be of great help in our process of making a better game.


Thank you for playing. Happy travels!
From the Shape of Dreams Development Team 💫
